neighbours.label: the token ' counter' opening 'counterattack' in a military narrative (not a shop or kitchen counter)
fire: At dawn the defenders mounted a counterattack and retook the village.
The regiment was pushed off the hill by a sudden counterattack from the east.
Two armoured brigades were held back for a counterattack on the bridgehead.
The Germans answered the landing with a fierce counterattack that night.
Commanders feared a counterattack before the trenches could be finished.
The division repelled one counterattack after another during the afternoon.
Reinforcements arrived just as the enemy began a counterattack on the left flank.
The marines dug in and waited for the expected counterattack along the beach.
quiet: At dawn the defenders mounted a patrol and searched the village.
The regiment was pushed off the hill by a sudden storm from the east.
Two armoured brigades were held back for a parade on the main square.
The clerk set the parcel on the counter and asked for a signature.
Commanders feared a mutiny before the trenches could be finished.
The shop sells over the counter medicines and a few herbal teas.
Reinforcements arrived just as the enemy began a withdrawal on the left flank.
The marines dug in and waited for the supply ships along the beach.

notes: Card: ' counter' x12 of top 32, all military (counterattack, counteroffensive, counterterrorism); also ' rounds' of ammunition. Probe: counterattack 0.51, counteroffensive 0.09, kitchen counter 0.01, tank rounds 0.20. The - pole is military unit nouns (detachment, unit, Company).
